title: RoFE: Rotated Frozen Embeddings for Low-Data Multimodal Tabular Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.31049v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal tabular learning combines tabular data with images and text, often in settings where labeled data are scarce. Tabular foundation models such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) offer a promising solution via in-context learning without task-specific training. However, modern image and text encoders produce embeddings with hundreds or thousands of dimensions, far exceeding the number of features encountered during PFN pretraining. Existing approaches bridge this gap using principal component analysis (PCA) to compress frozen embeddings. Surprisingly, we find that this PCA interface can underperform simple linear classifiers when labeled examples are scarce, even though PFNs are designed for small datasets. We identify the underlying failure mechanism: the PFN's per-column standardization removes the variances of the PCA scores. translated_title: RoFE：面向低数据多模态表格学习的旋转冻结嵌入
translated_abstract: 多模态表格学习将表格数据与图像和文本相结合，通常应用于标注数据稀缺的场景。诸如先验数据拟合网络（PFN）等表格基础模型通过上下文学习提供了一种有前景的解决方案，无需针对特定任务进行训练。然而，现代图像和文本编码器生成的嵌入具有数百甚至数千个维度，远远超过PFN预训练期间所遇到的特征数量。现有方法使用主成分分析（PCA）压缩冻结嵌入来弥合这一差距。令人惊讶的是，我们发现当标注样本稀缺时，这种PCA接口的表现甚至可能不如简单的线性分类器，尽管PFN本就是为小数据集设计的。我们揭示了其潜在的失败机制：PFN的按列标准化会消除PCA得分的方差。当PCA保留了标注样本的所有方向时，样本会塌缩成一个正则单纯形……
tldr: 该论文揭示了表格基础模型（PFN）中按列标准化会消除PCA压缩嵌入的方差、导致标注数据稀缺时PCA接口失效甚至不如线性分类器的失败机制，并提出RoFE（旋转冻结嵌入）作为低数据多模态表格学习的更优接口。
en_tdlr: RoFE identifies that per-column standardization in PFNs removes the variances of PCA scores, causing the PCA interface to underperform even linear classifiers in low-data regimes, and proposes rotated frozen embeddings as an improved interface for low-data multimodal tabular learning.
